top_signals.title: What Dimon, Solomon Said in Bank Earnings Calls
top_signals.summary: Goldman CEO David Solomon said IPO and capital-markets activity remained healthy, while JPMorgan's Jamie Dimon said the bank is tightening some credit terms, as top Wall Street banks reported earnings that failed to impress investors. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: US, China in 'Stability Mode': Kevin Rudd
top_signals.summary: Former Australian Prime Minister and Asia Society Global President & CEO says the US and China are in a "stability mode" where they have different national interests but no incentive to immediately ramp up political and trade tensions. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
